english.note: Use this when permission means official approval that must be obtained from an authority.
Use this for the approval or granting of permission, such as permission for a project.
Use this for official or administrative authorization, such as approval of an application or purchase order.
Use this when the approval is an official authorization, especially for a plan or application.
